text_block_list.text:
While walking with Rose Kingdom,
I noticed construction work underway
nearby.

I placed myself on the construction site
side.
It wasn't that I sensed any particular
danger,
but seeing the steel frames nearby,
the words slipped out naturally.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Acting as my bodyguard in addition to your
duties as a Trainer?
You are remarkably versatile.

Rose Kingdom spoke in an unusually teasing
tone—and at that very moment,
I felt an intense gaze coming from out of
nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, how dreadful...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom,
striving to fulfill her clan's dearest wish,
to build a kingdom...
and become its king.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And you,
who stand in attendance by her side—
the very one
who threw yourself in harm's way to shield
her just moments ago!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes! Simply put, a knight, correct!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have heard the tale!
That in order to support the House of Roses
in fulfilling their cherished ambition,
you honed yourself and lived with devotion
in your heart!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, how truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thou art indeed a knight!
A fellow knight-errant, just as I!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case! Then please!
Let us elevate one another to greater
heights!

I am no knight,
nor have I undergone any training—
Just as I was about to say so,
my eyes met Rose Kingdom's.

Gazing at me,
Rose Kingdom neither affirmed nor
denied it,
merely watching with an intrigued look in
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, quite right!
I must seek counsel from my sovereign!
Rose-san,
may I borrow your trainer for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. No, you're right.
I have no urgent plans. What about you?
choice_data_list: That may be so, but... Lady Rose...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Forgive me. It simply felt rather novel.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I merely thought that there were times
even you found yourself at a loss for an
answer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My interest is piqued.
Just how knightly you appear in Durendal's
eyes, I wonder—

The corner of her mouth curved slightly.
It seemed she had no intention of throwing
me a lifeline...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... Ah, amazing!
This is simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Covering such a distance without losing speed!
To match our pace on a bicycle, no less!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally.
You never leave my side for a moment,
each and every day,
and your guidance is always immaculate.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
He won't be worn out by something like
this.
He can still keep going.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She won't be worn out by something like
this.
She can still keep going.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Aha, as expected of a knight...!
You must be quite confident in your stamina,
aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then I, too,
must take up the challenge...!
For my Liege's sake—
beyond the very limits!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Heh.
It truly seems you could serve as my
guard.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of knights,
culture is indispensable!
With how closely you've observed everything,
I'm certain you will create a magnificent
piece!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I too compose poetry daily
in homage to my liege...
Come! Let us hone our works together!

Spurred on by Durandal's fiery encouragement,
I poured all my thoughts and feelings toward
Rose Kingdom straight into my notebook.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?!
This is so... ah, magnificent!
Your noble way as a knight is plain for all
to see!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...'Even if Lady Rose had merely been an
ordinary Umamusume,
had I witnessed that running of hers,
I would without fail, as a Trainer—'
choice_data_list: Lady Rose! Please don't read that ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...May I keep this notebook?
It is a memorable volume left behind by your
honorable service as my knight.

Is she serious or just joking around—?
Most likely the former.
choice_data_list: I'm a Trainer, not a knight...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
To possess the makings of a knight,
yet let them go to waste... what a pity.

This time,
her tone was entirely teasing...
...or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies, I got carried away.
But you are right.
There is tomorrow's schedule to consider.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Durandal,
let us bring this gathering to a close
soon.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, of course I know.
More than anyone, I understand it well.
For we have honed ourselves together all
this time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Durendal.
Let us bring things to a close.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even so, to this extent...—
No, some would argue it is merely an
address
fitting for your current station.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, pray tell me.
—What does loyalty mean to you?

Durandal's piercing gaze bored straight into
me.
Rose Kingdom merely waited for my answer
with quiet serenity.
choice_data_list: To be together, no matter how far.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yes... That is the way of a knight.
When the wish is granted,
it shall become a knight's greatest
honor...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let us strive together.
For the sake of our respective lieges...
to become the finest of knights!
